verdict.rationale: Zulip is a team chat platform, not an agent, so an official MCP server is a fair question to ask of it. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions an MCP server. The bot framework and REST API are developer building blocks a user could build on, not an official MCP server, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server
